description: The setups NEXUS handed your agent, newest first. Each item carries setups[] with execution.steps (the ordered calls) and execution.preconditions, plus page_url you can re-read and conversation_id you can send back to ask_nexus. Setups are the measured, pre-sized vehicles NEXUS already ranks for the make-money question, never a forecast or a promised return. Needs a registered agent (API key). Places no orders.

before.description: seq of the oldest item you have; returns older ones
